name: unsafe fn next_unchecked (& mut self) -> Self :: Item
rule: When using the default implementation of `next_unchecked`, the call to `self.next()` must return `Some`, not `None`, for the call to be safe.
api: trait UncheckedIterator  : TrustedLen { unsafe fn next_unchecked (& mut self) -> Self::Item }
expression: The requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL: it exposes neither default-implementation selection nor the result of `self.next()`.
